comment: PEDAL BUILD manifest for Deform (9-knob). Drive, soft crush and a one-knob compressor after the Torso S-4's Deform, with noise that follows your playing and a two-band Tilt. Split and Mode are named-step knobs (labels: build/selector_metadata.py); the rest are 0..100.
fxid_comment: 0x01A1. In this project's reserved 403-499 Delay block; free in every group's DB entry (498, the obvious gap, is the old NAMLite's and still in patches). Check repeat98's FXID registry before release.

params.name: Drive
params.comment: params[5]. 0..+36 dB into a soft, slightly uneven clipper; level held about even.

params.name: Crush
params.comment: params[6]. How far the crush goes (Mode picks how); 0 off.

params.name: Comp
params.comment: params[7]. One-knob compressor: threshold and ratio together, level made up.

params.name: Tilt
params.comment: params[8]. 50 flat; up pushes highs into the drive, down pushes lows. Half undone after.

params.name: Split
params.comment: params[9]. Named steps Low, Mid, High: Tilt's crossover, 80 Hz, 650 Hz, 2.5 kHz.

params.name: Mode
params.comment: params[10]. Named steps Bit, Redux, Both: fewer levels, lower sample rate, or both.

params.name: Noise
params.comment: params[11]. Pink noise that follows your playing, before the drive.

params.name: Decay
params.comment: params[12]. How long the noise hangs on after you stop, 20 ms .. 2 s.
